name: Adrift
source:
Following the (mis)adventures of a stag trying to learn magic and navigate the tense chaos of social interaction and romance. However, all may not be as it seems and horror may lurk just behind the corner. 

[From [url=https://jordanstags.itch.io/adrift]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随一只雄鹿试图学习魔法并驾驭社交互动和浪漫的紧张混乱的（错误）冒险。然而，一切可能并不像看上去的那样，恐怖可能就潜伏在角落后面。

[来自[url=https://jordanstags.itch.io/adrift]Itch.io[/url]]
